chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali from Aban ibn Uthman from Abu Maryam from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The young virgin girl who has a father cannot get married except with the permission of her father.
And he said: If she is in control of her affairs, she can get married whenever she desires.

key_terms.بِإِذْنِ أَبِيهَا: With the permission of her father

ai.seo_question: Does a virgin daughter need her father's permission to marry in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi delineates the fiqh of marriage consent by distinguishing between a virgin under paternal guardianship, whose marriage is contingent upon her father's permission, and a mature woman (malikat li-amriha) who possesses full autonomy to contract marriage independently. In Shia jurisprudence, this distinction underscores the father's role as the primary guardian for virgins while affirming the legal capacity of women who have reached maturity and independence to manage their own marital affairs.
